content.comment_body: Currently, there is no centralized thread listing all issues related to [version_no] HW8.3 and related software bugs; reports are scattered across various posts. HW8.3 appears to be the most problematic release so far; previous versions did not encounter so many issues (for example, with [article_no] FS:01, the Softkey function is faulty). --- [product_name] [version_no] --- On the address book page of [product_name] [version_no], entered values are not retained after closing the application. When restarted, the address book is empty again. The address book in [product_name] works as expected. Update: Testing under different operating systems shows that the address book functions correctly under Linux. Investigation revealed that address book entries are saved to [document]. Previously, I had changed directory ownership for the entire [product_name] installation directory to a regular user (myself), with write permission. When installed in Windows with administrator rights, permissions are set so that a regular user cannot write to the [document]. --- [product_name] [version_no] --- Occasionally, [product_name] [version_no] crashes without alert or explanation while saving a project; fortunately, this does not corrupt project files, though some changes are lost.
That's exactly the point. Consider renaming your topic to 'All HW8.3 and related software bugs' so that users can collectively report issues in one thread.

Your previous post was valid. If issues cannot be resolved through the forum, opening a support request is often suggested by experienced users. My feedback regarding the trend view axis lacking decimal points is not a bug, but rather an absent feature. Trend view works well and could be improved by allowing configuration of decimal points on axis values. If these concerns are considered bugs, it helps to mention them in a consolidated bug report thread.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have encountered numerous problems with [version_no] HW8.3 hardware and its supporting software, especially with [product_name] [version_no]. Common issues involve persistent software bugs such as address book data not saving on Windows, unpredictable application crashes, and perceived regressions from earlier versions. These frequent issues have led to user frustration, diminished trust, and less confidence, as previous versions were more stable.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the new HW8.3 hardware and corresponding software to be as stable and reliable as earlier releases, with core functionality such as saving address book entries and projects working smoothly across all operating systems.
